dialogue.origin: 今日は宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.origin: どうぞ宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Likewise, I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: お名前はなんと呼んだらいいですか
dialogue.content: What would you like me to call you?

dialogue.origin: はい、名前はゆかでお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please call me Yuka.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。本日よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I look forward to our session today.

dialogue.origin: はい、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, I look forward to it.

dialogue.origin: はじめに年齢、性別よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 51歳、女性です
dialogue.content: I'm 51 years old, and female.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日の相談したいことよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Now, could you please tell me what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: はい、娘の病気について悩んでします
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm struggling with my daughter's illness.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんの病気についてお悩みなんですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you're concerned about your daughter's illness.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もう少し詳しく聴いても大丈夫ですか?
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I asked a bit more about it?

dialogue.origin: 娘は27才なんですが、若年性の乳がんに罹ってしまいまして
dialogue.content: My daughter is 27, and she's been diagnosed with early-onset breast cancer.

dialogue.origin: 今治療中なのですが、見ていて辛くて
dialogue.content: She's currently undergoing treatment, and it's heartbreaking to watch.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは、とても、お辛いですね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very, very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 言葉で言い表せない辛いお気持ちが伝わってきます
dialogue.content: I can sense that you're feeling a pain that's hard to put into words.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 相談員さんは女性ですか？
dialogue.content: Are you a woman, if you don't mind my asking?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 女性ですよ
dialogue.content: Yes, I am a woman.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、では女性の気持ちが分かっていただけるかと思うのですが、若くしてまだ結婚もしていなのにお乳を全摘しなくてはならなくて。。。
dialogue.content: I see. Then I think you can understand how a woman would feel... She's so young, not even married yet, and she has to have a full mastectomy...

dialogue.origin: 娘さんが一番お辛いですけど、それはゆかさんも、同じ女性としてお母さんとしてもとてもお辛いですね
dialogue.content: Your daughter must be going through the most pain, but as a fellow woman and as her mother, this must be incredibly painful for you too, Yuka.

dialogue.origin: 変わってあげたくても変わってあげられない、私の育て方がいけなかったんじゃないのかとか、すごく考えてしまいます
dialogue.content: I wish I could take her place, but I can't. I keep wondering if I raised her wrong, if it's somehow my fault.

dialogue.origin: ゆかさんが、そこまで思ってしまうくらいの、お気持ちになられてるんですね
dialogue.content: I understand you're feeling so much that you're even starting to think that way.

dialogue.origin: はい、色々考えてかわいそうで、申し訳ない気持ちでつぶされそうです
dialogue.content: Yes, I think about so many things; I feel so sorry for her, and the guilt is crushing me.

dialogue.origin: 変わってあげたくてもかわれないのは、とても、お辛いと思います
dialogue.content: Wanting to take her place but being unable to must be incredibly painful.

dialogue.origin: はい、かわいそうで
dialogue.content: Yes, I just feel so sorry for her.

dialogue.origin: ゆかさんの優しい娘さんへの、お気持ちが痛いほど伝わってきます
dialogue.content: I can really feel your deep, tender feelings for your daughter, and how much this hurts you.

dialogue.origin: 娘は手術を決意したんですけど、決意するまでに私に心配かけまいと手術が決定してから打ち明けられて、一人でこんな重大なことを決めたんだと思うと心強い反面心配になります。
dialogue.content: My daughter decided to have the surgery, but she only told me after the decision was made, trying not to worry me. To think she made such a major decision all by herself... on one hand, I feel she's strong, but on the other, I'm so worried.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんゆかさんのことまで考えてられて、とても、考えてからの決意だったと思います
dialogue.content: Your daughter was even thinking about you, Yuka. I'm sure it was a decision she made after a great deal of thought.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私も母が乳がん全摘手術の時は辛い気持ちになりましたので
dialogue.content: My own mother had a full mastectomy for breast cancer, so I remember how painful that was.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね
dialogue.content: Oh, really?

dialogue.origin: 娘さんが乳がん全摘手術というのはお辛い気持ちでいっぱいだと思います。
dialogue.content: I can imagine you must be filled with sorrow about your daughter having a full mastectomy.

dialogue.origin: お辛いとは思いますが娘さんとは乳がんについて、お話することはありますか
dialogue.content: I know it must be difficult, but do you ever talk with your daughter about her breast cancer?

dialogue.origin: 娘が一番つらいだろうから、特に悲しそぶりは見せないようにしていますが、娘はこれからの事を悲観しています。
dialogue.content: I try not to show how sad I am, because I know she's the one who's hurting the most, but she's very pessimistic about the future.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そりゃそうだとおもいます、まだ27歳だし。しかも、これから抗がん剤をやるので妊娠できなくなるかもしれないと先生に言われたそうで・・・なんと声をかけていいやら・・・
dialogue.content: I can understand why. She's only 27. On top of that, the doctor apparently told her she might not be able to get pregnant because of the chemotherapy she'll be starting... I just don't know what to say to her...

dialogue.origin: 娘さんが一番お辛いですもんね。
dialogue.content: Your daughter is the one going through the most, isn't she?

dialogue.origin: 母親として、家族としてどう接すればいいか悩みます
dialogue.content: As her mother, and as a family, I don't know how we should act around her.

dialogue.origin: 先生にそこまで言われたら悲観的になるのも無理はないと思います
dialogue.content: After being told that by her doctor, it's no wonder she's feeling pessimistic.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 私が同じ立場でも家族として、どう接したらいいのか、きっと同じ様に悩むと思うので
dialogue.content: If I were in the same position, I'm sure I would be just as worried about how to act as a family member.

dialogue.origin: 娘の事をかんがえて、実は毎日泣いて暮らしています
dialogue.content: To be honest, I think about my daughter and cry every single day.

dialogue.origin: それは、とても、お辛いですよね。毎日泣いてしまってるんですね
dialogue.content: That must be so painful. You find yourself crying every day.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なさけないですね
dialogue.content: I feel so pathetic.

dialogue.origin: そんなことないですよ
dialogue.content: No, not at all.

dialogue.origin: 私でも同じ様に泣いてしまうと思います。お若い娘さんなら尚更だと思います。
dialogue.content: I think I would cry the same way. All the more so with such a young daughter.

dialogue.origin: 娘が一番大変なのに情けないけど、私の気持ちがついていけない、自分の方がまだましだと思ってしまいます。
dialogue.content: I know my daughter is having the hardest time, and it feels pathetic, but my emotions just can't keep up. I end up thinking that I have it easier than she does.

dialogue.origin: 夫には毎日泣いていたら体に良くないといわれるんですけど、涙が止まらなくて
dialogue.content: My husband tells me it's not good for my health to cry every day, but the tears just won't stop.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。とても、お辛いですよね。
dialogue.content: I understand. That must be so difficult.

dialogue.origin: どうしらいいのでしょう
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: 旦那さんにも心配されてるんですね。お優しい旦那さんですね。
dialogue.content: Your husband is worried about you as well. He sounds very kind.

dialogue.origin: そうですかね
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: はい。お優しいと思います。旦那さんに相談されることはできてますか
dialogue.content: Yes, I think he is kind. Have you been able to talk to your husband about this?

dialogue.origin: もちろん、話してるけど、男性だから、そこまで気持ちがわからない部分もあるだろうし、ショックを受けるだろうから、はっきり病状を伝えていない部分もあるのでそこまで相談できていないです
dialogue.content: Of course, I talk to him, but he's a man, so there are parts he might not fully understand, and I know he'd be shocked, so there are details about her condition I haven't told him. So I haven't been able to fully confide in him.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 旦那さんは男性ですし気持ちのわからない部分も多いですもんね
dialogue.content: Your husband is a man, so there are probably many things he doesn't understand about how you feel.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: お辛いと思いますが、ゆかさんの少しでも、お気持ちが楽になるときはありますか❔
dialogue.content: I know it's hard, but are there any moments when you feel even a little lighter, Yuka?

dialogue.origin: 娘が死んじゃったらと思うと悲しくて前を向きたくないです
dialogue.content: When I think about my daughter dying, I get so sad that I don't want to look forward.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね今はとてもお辛いですね
dialogue.content: I understand. It's incredibly painful for you right now.

dialogue.origin: 娘が死んだら、私生きていけない気がします
dialogue.content: If my daughter dies, I feel like I won't be able to go on living.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。押しつぶされそうな、お気持ちが伝わってきます耐えられないですよね
dialogue.content: I understand. I can feel that you're on the verge of being crushed. It must be unbearable.

dialogue.origin: 本当に
dialogue.content: It really is.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 娘が死んじゃう夢を見て泣きながら起きるんです、もう朝が来るのが怖い
dialogue.content: I have dreams where my daughter dies and I wake up crying. I'm afraid of the morning coming now.

dialogue.origin: 周りにも中々相談したり、しにくいと思うので
dialogue.content: It must be difficult to talk about this with people around you.

dialogue.origin: 翌日起きるのも怖いほどの状態なんですね。
dialogue.content: So you're at a point where you're even afraid to wake up the next day.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 話しにくいお悩みを話していただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing something so hard to talk about.

dialogue.origin: ええ、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 少しでも話すことで気持ちが少しでも楽になれたらいいですが
dialogue.content: I hope that talking about it, even a little, has helped ease your mind somewhat.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、少しすっきりした気がしますが、また泣いて暮らすと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, I feel a little clearer, but I think I'll still go back to crying my days away.

dialogue.origin: 今日はお話しできてないことはありませんか❔大丈夫ですか。少しでもスッキリできればと思います
dialogue.content: Is there anything else you wanted to talk about today? Are you okay? I hope you were able to get some relief.

dialogue.origin: もう時間ですものね、だいじょうぶです。今日は聞いていただいてありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: It's about time, isn't it? I'm okay. Thank you for listening to me today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。お話ししていただけてありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: No, thank you. I appreciate you sharing your story with me.

dialogue.origin: また、いつでも相談に来てくださいね
dialogue.content: Please feel free to come back and talk anytime.

dialogue.origin: はい、では（ありがとうございました。失礼します）
dialogue.content: Yes, then—thank you very much. Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you again.

dialogue.origin: また、よろしくお願いいたします。失礼致しますね
dialogue.content: I look forward to seeing you again. Goodbye for now.

topic.sub: 娘の病気による家族の心の負担
